[[File:Ankou icon.png|left]]
'''Ankou''' are [[undead]] monsters found on the fourth level of the [[Stronghold of Security]] and in the [[Wilderness Crater]]. They are described by the Slayer Master [[Vannaka]] as "neither skeleton nor ghost, but a combination of both."

Ankou are weak against Earth spells and the [[Salve amulet]]. In free worlds, they are often attacked because of their high experience yield and decent drops, although some players will kill them solely for their [[left skull half]] drops. In combat, ankou act similar to attackable human NPCs by punching their opponents.

The ankou is the only monster to drop the left skull half, a component needed to assemble the [[skull sceptre]]. Wearing [[Varrock armour]] while killing them increases the chance of receiving this component of the skull sceptre.

When killing ankou, an [[ankou (elite)|elite]] version may spawn (guaranteed while on a Slayer assignment), the chance of which can be further increased with the use of [[fellstalk incense sticks]].

==Trivia==
* In {{Wp|Breton mythology}}, the {{Wp|ankou}} is a personification of death. The word ankou in the {{Wp|Breton language}} means {{Wp|Death (personification)|Grim Reaper}}.
* Although the examine info says, "A bony ghost." they do not count towards a [[Slayer]] assignment of ghosts. Instead, they are a Slayer task by themselves while also counting towards skeleton assignments.
* They used to be located in the [[Forinthry Dungeon]], but were replaced by [[dark beast]]s on [[8 August]] [[2016]] as part of the [[Update:Wilderness Improvements & Task Set|Wilderness Improvements]] update.
* Due to excessive botting, ankou had their health boosted. This led to player complaints as the ankou then had too many life points for low-levelled players. The boost was eventually reverted with the update on [[17 October]] [[2016]].
* Prior to a hidden update in late 2024, Ankou could only drop [[ghost hunter equipment]] and [[Cremation]] in members' worlds. {{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Stu|url=https://twitter.com/JagexStu/status/1042479114899349505|quote=I had a quick look at the ankou death scripts (including elites) to confirm. They only drop Cremation/herb-burner/ghosthunter/essence on member worlds.
The above ninja fix requested only ghosts, and ankou aren't classified as ghosts (they have a distinct Slayer category).|date=18 September 2018|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/beaTR|archivedate=30 October 2019|}} They can now drop ghost hunter equipment and Cremation in free-to-play worlds.
